strictToolSchemaDivergence.whereVerified: execute-238-confirmation.ts and execute-231-final-acceptance.ts both build the tool block manually without strict, and §242A instructed §243 to use the same assembly path. §243 followed it exactly.
strictToolSchemaDivergence.consequence: required-field enforcement was advisory on every §243 call. FOUR of the fourteen refusals (G4, G8, C3, M5) are pure required-field conformance failures that a strict tool mode is designed to prevent, and two calls (C7 and M5) returned schema-artifact placeholders that strict mode would reject outright.
strictToolSchemaDivergence.whatThisDoesNotExcuse: TEN of the fourteen refusals carry semantic-coherence codes that no schema enforcement can prevent: a driver role contradicting its candidate state, an established cessation driver under a non-STOP posture, a resumption dependency under a permitting posture, a duplicated basis reference, and a driver role on an inadmissible carrier. The majority of the Q13 shortfall is the candidate's own coherence, not the transport configuration.
strictToolSchemaDivergence.wasAnythingRerun: NO. Changing the configuration after seeing the result would be repairing the experiment, which the authorization forbids.
